purpose: First external live/dead experiment; no competition inference
test_policy: Do not download, open, transform, train on or score sealed test matches in this experiment

selection.test_release: Separate explicit final evaluation after model selection

features: geometry, symmetric team distances, ball/player motion, observed fractions and explicit missingness; no IDs, ownership/status, events, team names, period clock or ball height
temporal_policy: Offline centred context; reset at observation sequence boundaries
limitations: Tiny seven-match collection; repeated teams; DFL label conventions and clean tracking may not transfer to Metrica
